note: Holdout prompts written after the lexicon was tuned on prompts.json. Do not tune against this file; use it to estimate generalization.

positives.query: Can you talk about a moment where you had to convince your manager your idea was right?
What's the hardest piece of criticism you've gotten, and what did you do with it?
Tell me about a deadline you almost missed.
Which part of your resume are you most proud of and why did you go into PM?
How do you go about understanding your customers?
Tell me about a time you tried a bold approach that might not have worked.
Have you made any manual workflow more efficient?
How did you know whether the analysis was actually correct before you changed the plan?
What would you do in your first 90 days on our team?
Suppose leadership asks you to build something your users clearly don't want. What then?
Tell me about the people you collaborated with on the Model Hub.
Tell me about a time you helped out on work that wasn't technically yours.
说说你在团队里遇到的一次冲突，你是怎么处理的？
你觉得一个好的产品经理需要具备什么能力？
你最喜欢的微软产品是什么，有什么可以改进的？

What do you think the biggest risk to the cloud market is next year?
Is there anything else you'd like us to know?
